Scientific imports in the runtime adapter remain inside create_runtime and were not imported or executed by this review.

The C1 builder copies the sealed S40 variant, runtime, limits, components and all non-seed controls. The input is the preregistered jesus.jpg byte identity and controls.seed is 43. The only runtime-config content change is the unique seed line; output path, row labels, source/review identities and timestamps are isolated administrative fields.

The gate requires the exact four S39 loading records and independent review, one factory call, zero generation, zero requested codec calls, complete state-dict loads and a non-original ft-mse identity. It also requires the S39 parent input to equal the old S40 changi input and to differ from the new C1 input. The C1 config is separately derived and bound; no S39 record is represented as C1 input or generation evidence.

Prepare hashes all 663677 C1 input bytes and the small config derivation. At execution the full C1 gate hashes the input and config before the worker loads scientific modules; the runtime adapter and the transformed S35 factory validate the same gate before model construction and again after loading. No pixel decode occurs in either gate or freeze tool.

The metadata receipt declares zero C1 input-body reads and explicitly records the 880 bytes of the seed-43 config read to prove derivation. The nested S39 parent validation may rehash its separately scoped old changi/config records; those reads do not establish or consume C1 input evidence and decode no pixels.

The adapter preserves the pinned S35 constructor except the one gate import, four evidence labels and four seed constants. It then requires diffusers 0.32.2, untiled/unsliced VAE, sample size 256, four latent channels, wrapper chunk 1, scale 0.18215 and downsample 8, and rejects every incomplete state-dict load. Exact original SD2.1 equivalence and codec numerics remain explicitly false.

Independent AST reconstruction found one HERE reassignment, two resource-gate routes, one runtime-factory route and label counts 1,1,1,1,3,2,2. Restoring those exact edits recovers the complete pinned S35 launcher AST. Therefore the original initialize, turn_left(5), turn_right(5), shared-pipeline/RNG, history 1 to 5 to 9, archive, trace, process-tree and budget logic remain unchanged.

The prepare, attachment, execution_01 and scientific output roots resolve to four distinct paths and were all absent at review time. The freeze tool accepts only its two exact create-only output paths and rechecks the fixed scientific and execution roots. The final launcher consumes an exact manifest SHA, enforces the manifest's fixed scientific output root, and retains the caller-supplied execution directory in its launch receipt; the later launch command must use the protocol-fixed execution_01 path.

Prepare creates an exclusive read-only core. Attach re-derives that core, verifies its file and canonical hashes, accepts exactly two distinct non-root reviewer roles with exact row, variant, status, core and zero-execution bindings, inserts only review_receipts, proves the review-excluded core hash unchanged, then runs metadata validation on the exact final manifest SHA.

Attempt directories and JSON files are created exclusively. A caught prepare/attach failure is terminal in that already-created directory and receives a failure receipt; no old attempt is overwritten. The inherited launcher also creates its execution directory exclusively, preserves worker/monitor/partial archive evidence and terminates tracked descendants on failure or resource breach.

The protocol and receipts keep manifest readiness separate from generation, archive/readback validity, blind scoring, visual camera obedience, quality, cohort outcome, method gain and novelty. C2 remains mandatory regardless of C1.
